plain_statement: Take an AND/OR circuit, each gate listing two earlier wires, on N point then N line inputs. A view makes each cross gate (AND gates with no line-free input and not two point-free inputs) an OR listing one of its inputs twice. (a) The circuit is true exactly when every view is. (b) Each view is such a circuit of the same size with no cross gate, each wire at least the circuit's. (c) A view wire reading lines, no point, equals with no point on the OR of point-free circuit wires reached downwards through view ORs reading points and lines in the circuit.
title: Views of an AND/OR fan-in-two circuit: selection identity, each view a KM0 circuit of equal size above it, and view expansion
